# Preact

Preact 10.29.8 (MIT), used only by the mobile motion lyrics page: it runs the
desktop React component of MotionLyrics.js inside the iOS and Android apps
(see mobile/motion and .github/scripts/build_motion_mobile.mjs). Spicetify
itself keeps using Spotify's React.
